comment: Era transition cards: PAST — SOLVE / PRESENT — INVESTIGATE / FUTURE — SURVIVE. skipTo(i) mounts each era through the real levels.load() path, so the card fires from the same code as a genuine era arrival. Verifies text, era accent colour, auto-hide and that pointer lock/loading are untouched.

steps.eval: JSON.stringify({ dt: Math.round(performance.now() - window.__t0), card: !document.getElementById('era-card').classList.contains('hidden'), tag: document.getElementById('era-card-tag').textContent, title: document.getElementById('era-card-title').textContent, line: document.getElementById('era-card-line').textContent, era: document.body.dataset.era, accent: getComputedStyle(document.body).getPropertyValue('--accent').trim(), mode: __game.mode(), pointerLockTouched: document.pointerLockElement !== null })

steps.comment: Beauty shot: re-show the same era-1 card (its 4.7s timer fired during the heavy lab build's main-thread block). Uses the real mounted meta.

steps.eval: (() => { const m = __game.levels.meta; __game.ui.eraCard({ numeral: m.numeral, title: m.title, sub: m.subtitle, tag: m.name, verb: 'Investigate', line: 'Ari lands back in the lab on the very night of the accident — investigate the blackout and take back the second core.' }); return 'reshown'; })()
